messages:
sam-cs: Customer on mobile SDK (iOS) reports structured JSON mode responses getting cut off mid-object when using streaming. They see trailing '...\n' and then the connection closes, invalid JSON parse on client. request_id=rid_7b2c

sam-cs: Customer says it only happens when they route via our partner proxy (Cloudflare) — direct requests to api.redwood.ai are fine. Happens intermittently, ~1 in 200 streams.

sam-cs: Pasted minimal client error: `JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at line 1 column 234` and raw chunk: `{\"choices\": [{\"delta\": {\"content\": \"{\\\"user\\\":\\\"alice\\\",\\\"result\\\": [1,2` then socket closed.

alex-infra: Can you capture the full raw HTTP chunks and proxy logs? suspect proxy buffering/idle timeout or connection reset. Also need upstream response headers (Transfer-Encoding, Connection) and status.

sam-cs: Uploading snippets — below is the curl reproduction they gave (direct to partner edge):

```bash
curl -i -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\" -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \\
  \"https://edge.partner.example/proxy/v1/streams?model=gpt-open\" \\
  -d '{"prompt":"emit json mode output","stream":true}'
```

sam-cs: Their raw capture (client side) shows: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Date: Tue, 11 Mar 2025 15:20:00 GMT
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Content-Type: text/event-stream

9f
data: {\"choices\": [{\"delta\": {\"content\": \"{\\\"id\\\": \\\"123\\\", \\\"items\\\": [1,2,3\"}}]} 

3a
data: {\"choices\": [{\"delta\": {\"content\": \",4,5]}", \"finish_reason\": \"stop\"}}]

0

```

sam-cs: Notice chunk boundary split inside the JSON array `...,3"}}]}`

alex-infra: That looks like chunk boundaries cutting mid-json. Cloudflare (and other proxies) may buffer or coalesce and sometimes close the connection on idle or body size thresholds. Did they set `Origin:`, or `Connection: keep-alive`? Any `cf-` headers in the response?

sam-cs: From partner edge logs: `cf-ray: 7abc1234`, `cf-request-id: 012345`. We also have upstream request id: `rid_7b2c` in our logs (matched). Upstream shows continuous token streaming from runtime until final chunk. No runtime error.

mira-eng: Two questions: 1) Is our runtime sending valid SSE frames (prefixed `data: ` and `\n\n`)? 2) Are we emitting unescaped JSON blobs (raw JSON inside the SSE data) or embedding JSON inside strings? If the client expects to parse streaming JSON by concatenation, chunk boundaries will break it. Recommend we verify our streaming format.

sam-cs: Customer is using `structured_output: json` mode — our runtime emits chunks with partial JSON fragments (we expect client to assemble). They reported client library concatenates data events and parses at end. Fails because proxy sometimes cuts final chunk.

kate-ops: Short-term mitigation for customers: 1) enable framing at app layer (prefix each full JSON object with length header), 2) switch to newline-delimited JSON where each event is a complete JSON object terminated by `\n`, or 3) use an explicit SSE event per complete object. For this customer, ask partner to disable response buffering and increase streaming idle timeouts.

alex-infra: Repro suggestion for us: run the same curl but add artificially small TCP window and then trigger an edge reset to simulate partner behavior. Also try with `--no-buffer` and with `-H \"Connection: close\"` to see if proxy coalesces differently.

sam-cs: Customer repro steps they gave: 1) Start mobile app, 2) trigger streaming request, 3) background phone to trigger slower network, 4) wait ~8-12s, 5) sometimes the stream ends with partial JSON and parse error. They captured pcap showing `RST` from partner edge.

mira-eng: If partner sends `RST`/`FIN` mid-stream, there's nothing we can do to magically complete the JSON. But we can harden client SDK: attempt to buffer until either close+parse or include a small checksum/terminator token from runtime. Propose we add a `streaming_last_chunk` marker in our SSE payloads for structured mode so truncated streams are detectable.

sam-cs: Filed a partner escalation ticket asking them to check `proxy_buffering off`, `sendfile off`, and larger `proxy_read_timeout`. Included `rid_7b2c` and the pcap attached.

engbot: Alert: 2025-03-11T15:19:59Z streaming-error-rate spike (5xx proxy close) for model=gpt-open; sample rid=rid_7b2c.

alex-infra: For our infra follow-ups: - add debug logging around final chunk write path to ensure flush completes before socket close - instrument per-request `Content-MD5` (or length marker) header when structured_output enabled so client can validate.

mira-eng: Long-term: change default of structured output streaming to emit complete JSON objects per event (ndjson or framed) rather than arbitrary token fragments. That will make proxy truncation less likely to produce syntactically valid but incomplete JSON. Also update mobile SDK to handle truncated stream gracefully (retry/resume).

sam-cs: Next steps assigned: sam-cs -> confirm partner config and share mitigation; alex-infra -> add per-request length marker prototype; mira-eng -> design streaming marker change and SDK fallback. Will loop back once partner responds. :thumbsup:
